text: You will never need the gym again after this. Put chia seeds in a glass of warm water and let them soak overnight. Chia seeds absorb up to 12 times their weight in water when you let them rest to gel forms that once inside your body acts like a sponge. It drags out accumulated fat, cleans the walls of your intestine, and removes what has been stuck in there for weeks. The next day, squeeze half a lemon and add two tablespoons of apple cider vinegar. The lemon activates your liver first thing in the morning and kickstarts fat burning before you have even had breakfast. Apple cider vinegar stabilizes your blood sugar and stops the insulin spikes that make your body store fat nonstop. Drink it on an empty stomach, slowly no rush. But here is what nobody tells you. Most people have been fighting their weight for years, trying every diet, counting calories, going hungry, and the belly stays the same because the problem was never what you eat. The problem is that your body has been in survival mode for months. Stress releases cortisol, and cortisol tells your body to store everything. It does not matter what you eat or how much you move. If your nervous system is on alert, your body is going to keep accumulating. During the first weeks, you will notice the bloating going down, your belly flattening, more energy and cravings disappearing. But this drink cleans from the outside. If on the inside you are still living, stressed, and accumulating tension, your body is going to keep storing. The real change begins when you calm what is happening inside of you. Write in the comments, health, if you are going to start tomorrow. And if you want to go beyond a recipe and learn how to calm your body and mind from the root so the weight truly releases, I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside The Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile.
